# Protocols

The agent protocols Datalayer targets, one spec each under `agentspecs/protocols/`.
An agent spec or an application lists the ones it speaks in `protocols`; an
application may not list a planned one, and its `pap`, `pact` and `a2a` blocks
are refused unless their protocol is listed.

| Protocol | Id | Layer | Publisher | Version implemented | Status | Connects to | Appspec block |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Agent2Agent](https://a2a-protocol.org) | `a2a` | transport | Google, now the Linux Foundation | 1.0 | shipped | Other agents, each at its address with its Agent Card | `a2a` |
| [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification) | `mcp` | transport | Anthropic | 2026-07-28 (Python), 2025-11-25 (TypeScript) | shipped | Tools, resources and prompts served by MCP servers |  |
| [Personal Agent Consent & Trust](https://openpactprotocol.org) | `pact` | consent | Decagon, Instinct | 1.0 | shipped | Businesses' agents, asked for a person with their delegation | `pact` |
| [Personal Agent Protocol](https://poppy.md) | `pap` | consent | Sierra, Meta | draft 0.1 | shipped | Companies, as a person's agent there, or being one | `pap` |
| [Trusted Agent Protocol](https://developer.visa.com/capabilities/trusted-agent-protocol/trusted-agent-protocol-specifications) | `tap` | identity | Visa | draft (Merchant Specifications, read 2026-10-13) | planned | Merchants that recognise an agent by its signature |  |
| [Web Bot Auth](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol/) | `web-bot-auth` | identity | Cloudflare (IETF draft) | draft-ietf-webbotauth-httpsig-protocol-00 | shipped | Websites, which can tell the application's requests from someone pretending |  |
| [Agentic Commerce Protocol](https://github.com/agentic-commerce-protocol/agentic-commerce-protocol) | `acp` | commerce | OpenAI, Stripe | 2026-04-17 | shipped | Sellers, to check out with a delegated payment |  |
| [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp) | `ucp` | commerce | Google, with Shopify and retailers | 2026-08-25 | shipped | Merchants, to search, check out and follow orders |  |
| [A2UI](https://a2ui.org) | `a2ui` | ui | Google | 0.9 | shipped | The person, through components an answer draws |  |
| [AG-UI](https://docs.ag-ui.com) | `ag-ui` | ui | CopilotKit | 0.0.57 (@ag-ui/core) | shipped | The page a person talks to the agent on |  |

## Each protocol

### Agent2Agent (`a2a`)

How agents talk to agents: teams and scenes talk over it, an application's route serves it, and its Agent Card advertises its extensions.

- Python: `fasta2a`, `a2a-sdk`
- TypeScript: `@a2a-js/sdk`

### A2UI (`a2ui`)

How an agent's answer becomes an interface: components the host renders from a declarative surface.

- Python: `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@a2ui/react`, `@a2ui/web_core`

### Agentic Commerce Protocol (`acp`)

Checkout sessions at a seller, completed with a payment the model never sees. In applications at test merchants only, with no real payment token (decided 2026-10-13): each purchase asked of the person first, made at most once.

- Python: `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@datalayer/agent-runtimes`
- Its tools' action classes: `protocol-tools/agentic-commerce.yaml`

### AG-UI (`ag-ui`)

How an agent streams its run to a page: messages, tool calls and state as events.

- Python: `ag-ui-protocol`
- TypeScript: `@ag-ui/client`, `@ag-ui/core`

### Model Context Protocol (`mcp`)

How an agent calls tools and reads resources: clients and servers in both languages, and the MCP gateway every connection goes through.

- Python: `mcp`
- TypeScript: `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, `@mcp-ui/client`

### Personal Agent Consent & Trust (`pact`)

A personal agent asking a business's agent over A2A, first as itself, then for a person who delegated some of their permissions.

- Python: `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@datalayer/agent-runtimes`
- Its tools' action classes: `protocol-tools/pact.yaml`

### Personal Agent Protocol (`pap`)

A person's agent working with a company for them — signed out, then signed in at the company, its changes confirmed by the person — and an application being a company personal agents reach.

- Python: `personal-agent-protocol`
- TypeScript: `@datalayer/personal-agent-protocol`
- Its tools' action classes: `protocol-tools/pap.yaml`

### Trusted Agent Protocol (`tap`)

An agent-recognition profile over Web Bot Auth for merchants: a signature tagged agent-browser-auth to browse or agent-payer-auth to pay. Built as a draft from Visa's public Merchant Specifications (2026-10-13) in agent-runtimes; planned for applications until Visa confirms it.

- Python: `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@datalayer/agent-runtimes`, `http-message-sig`

### Universal Commerce Protocol (`ucp`)

Shopping at a merchant: catalogue, checkout and orders, every purchase an exact proposal the person approves. In applications at test merchants only, with no real payment (decided 2026-10-13): each purchase asked of the person first, made at most once.

- Python: `ucp-sdk`, `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@ucp-js/sdk`, `@datalayer/agent-runtimes`
- Its tools' action classes: `protocol-tools/ucp.yaml`

### Web Bot Auth (`web-bot-auth`)

Signed outbound requests (RFC 9421) and the key directory a website checks them against.

- Python: `agent-runtimes`
- TypeScript: `@datalayer/agent-runtimes`, `web-bot-auth`
